data.body: Correction: TDD contract card without shell interpolation. Authoritative contract is reasonable-kingsize-polliwog ACs plus cinderlike-weariful-angora real-Git protocol and large-contrast constraints. Preconditions: the macOS CI-shaped baseline command passed 9 tests; three workers each paid 33.23 to 33.49 seconds setup, pytest wall was 78.85 seconds, and process real time was 113.08 seconds. Tier is a real pytest integration fixture through an isolated loopback git daemon and real git fetch, worktree, repack, and push subprocesses; a lower tier cannot prove protocol negotiation or pack behavior. Exact postconditions: size-independent paths use a full-history server below 1 MiB while filtered fetches negotiate blob:none and omit its historical blob; the larger-than-100-MiB full-versus-filtered guard remains real; identity and reconvergence/push behavior remain green. Negative control and defect seed: full small fetch contains the historical blob, while replacing its small payload with the 141 MiB payload fails the below-1-MiB oracle. Collateral invariants: workflows, named and direct fetch semantics, complete event convergence, and guard thresholds stay unchanged. Gate: CI-shaped integration command plus project lint, typecheck, and test. Contention exemption: isolated fixture setup adds no composed store lock, retry, or cache. Surface census: CLI IN via real git subprocesses; MCP/API OUT because there is no corresponding operation; public library IN via rebar.init_repo; automated callers IN via parsed standalone and Gerrit workflows; dual direction IN via blobless read and reconvergence push. RED evidence: 7 modified or new oracle cases all failed for the intended missing small_ticket_server fixture, covering protocol and size, both identity lanes, full-fetch contrast, and reconvergence push; there was no import or typo failure.
